rules.title: Data attributes for selectors
rules.text: Select elements with dedicated data-cy or data-testid attributes, not CSS classes, ids or text that may change.

rules.title: Control the network
rules.text: Stub or wait on network calls with cy.intercept aliases instead of fixed waits.

rules.title: Independent specs
rules.text: Make each spec set up its own state through API calls and not depend on other specs.

rules.title: Programmatic login
rules.text: Log in through the API with cy.session instead of through the UI in every test.
